title: Joint Classification and Generation on Tabular Data: an Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.32225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many applications of machine learning on tabular data need both a classifier and a generator of realistic records. The default is to train two separate models, whereas a single joint model promises both from one set of weights. Several families of tabular deep learning models can be turned into such a joint model, which raises the question of which joint model is preferable at which computational budget. In this empirical study, we introduce and compare joint models based on four state-of-the-art tabular data modeling families (energy-based models, probabilistic circuits, tabular foundation models and tabular diffusion models) against measured FLOPs and wall-clock time, on 29 classification datasets. Methods are evaluated based on two defined aggregate scores that take into account different aspects of prediction and generation. translated_title: 表格数据上的联合分类与生成：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 机器学习在表格数据上的许多应用既需要一个分类器，也需要一个能生成真实记录的生成器。默认做法是训练两个独立的模型，而单一的联合模型有望仅用一组权重同时实现两者。多个表格深度学习模型家族都可以被改造成这样的联合模型，这就引出了一个问题：在何种计算预算下，哪种联合模型更为可取。在这项实证研究中，我们在29个分类数据集上引入并比较了基于四个最先进的表格数据建模家族（基于能量的模型、概率电路、表格基础模型和表格扩散模型）构建的联合模型，并以实测的FLOPs和挂钟时间作为衡量标准。这些方法基于两个定义的聚合分数进行评估，这两个分数综合考虑了预测和生成的不同方面。随后，我们还将这些联合模型与独立的分类器和生成器的各种组合在不同计算预算下进行了比较。
tldr: 本文系统比较了基于能量模型、概率电路、表格基础模型和表格扩散模型四类最先进方法构建的联合分类与生成模型，在29个数据集上评估了不同计算预算下它们与独立“分类器+生成器”组合的优劣。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares joint classification-and-generation models built from four state-of-the-art tabular modeling families (energy-based models, probabilistic circuits, tabular foundation models, and tabular diffusion models) on 29 datasets, evaluating which joint model is preferable at which computational budget compared to separate classifier-generator pairs.
